description: S14c We Talked About This (bản da đen), file 08: S16 → S19. Tải vào mỗi node IMG_ ảnh đã chọn ở 0A/0B của node cùng tên (bỏ IMG_). Chạy F_ (xem khung) → T_/V_ → TAI.

nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the empty kitchen at night: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is her son's character sheet: use it only for his face, skin tone, haircut, beard and clothes. Image 3 shows the brochure: use it only for its size and cover. Medium shot. The photo shows her son at the kitchen counter at night, one hand flat on the brochure lying on the counter. Her son: a 46-year-old Black American man with deep brown skin, a low taper fade with a little grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a tense jaw and a gold wedding band. He wears a navy quarter-zip pullover and chinos. The brochure is a glossy senior-living brochure whose cover photo shows smiling seniors at a communal dining table. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: night, the kitchen lit only by the warm yellow range-hood light, the rest of the room falling into soft shadow, quiet and tense. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: her son is the same man as in his character sheet, with the same skin tone, haircut and beard. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.

Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Real-time pace, nothing slow-motion; the main action starts within the first second.
